title: Genie 4: A new generation of world simulation
headline: Google DeepMind releases Genie 4 world model research preview with safety guardrails
summary: Google DeepMind has announced Genie 4, a multimodal world model capable of real-time interactive simulation, including native audio and physics-based environments. The model is currently available as a research preview for trusted testers, with plans for broader release to Google AI Ultra subscribers and API partners. The system incorporates safety guardrails and SynthID digital watermarking to manage risks associated with generated content.
why_it_matters: The integration of safety guardrails and digital watermarking in high-fidelity simulation models highlights the evolving industry standard for managing provenance and safety risks in generative AI deployments.

quotes.text: Genie 4 includes strict safety guardrails that are consistent with our safety policies across other models. Before launching this preview, we evaluated Genie 4 through internal rigorous safety evaluations to prevent the generation of harmful or malicious content.

To maintain transparency, all video and audio generated by Genie 4 will include SynthID, our imperceptible digital watermarking technology that helps identify AI-generated content across visual and audio modalities.

classification.significance_reason: The release demonstrates the application of safety-by-design principles, including watermarking and internal evaluation, to advanced generative simulation models.
